title: Preterite for completed events
text: The preterite narrates completed past events with a clear end: ayer hablé con Ana, fui al cine. B1 conversation grammar.

concept.name: Preterite for completed events
concept.description: Narrating finished, completed actions in the past with the preterite (hablé, comí, fui).

probes.prompt: Complete: Ayer yo ___ con mi hermana. (hablar)
Complete: El sábado ella ___ al cine. (ir)

title: Imperfect for descriptions and habits
text: The imperfect describes habits and background in the past: de niño jugaba en el parque, hacía sol. B1 conversation grammar.

concept.name: Imperfect for descriptions and habits
concept.description: Describing background, habits and ongoing past states with the imperfect (hablaba, comía, era).

probes.prompt: Complete: De niño yo ___ en el parque todos los días. (jugar)

title: Expressing opinions
text: Opinions in conversation: creo que, pienso que, me parece que, en mi opinión; ask with ¿qué piensas de...? B1 conversation.

concept.name: Expressing opinions
concept.description: Giving and asking for opinions with creo que, pienso que, me parece que and en mi opinión.

probes.prompt: Give your opinion: ___ que el libro es interesante. (creer, yo)
Ask for an opinion: ¿Qué ___ de la película? (pensar, tú)

title: Preterite and imperfect in storytelling
text: Storytelling contrast: the imperfect sets the scene and the preterite tells what happened: llovía cuando llegué. B1 conversation.

concept.name: Preterite and imperfect in storytelling
concept.description: Contrasting preterite and imperfect when telling a story: the imperfect sets the scene, the preterite moves the plot.

probes.prompt: Which form tells the event: Mientras leía, sonó / sonaba el teléfono?

title: Disagreeing with the subjunctive
text: Disagreeing politely: after no creo que and no pienso que use the subjunctive: no creo que sea verdad. B1 conversation.

concept.name: Disagreeing with the subjunctive
concept.description: Negated opinions (no creo que, no pienso que) take the subjunctive: no creo que sea verdad.

probes.prompt: Complete: No pienso que ella ___ razón. (tener)

title: Reference: conversation strategies
text: Keep a conversation going with follow-up questions: ¿Y tú? ¿Qué piensas? Example: Me parece que sí, ¿y a ti?
